subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the cost-per-sale program for {Brand}, after my earlier emails on validated web orders and the incrementality read. If adding return-adjusted Canadian orders on a pay-per-result basis is on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the category-level sales view and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN ecommerce CPS: references prior outreach + earlier stages so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with easy out (release if timing wrong); no figure, no illustrative flag; 0 question marks; no sign-off; native English; no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
